address_format_hint: Format: http://ip:port/rtp/10.10.[1-20].[1-20]:5002 | Sync multi-place: [1-100:n]/{n} (n stays in sync)
analyzeduration_override_desc: Overrides the demuxer analysis duration in seconds. Leave 0 for auto (5s for live, 2s for FCC). Increase if streams take too long to load or fail with corrupt packet warnings.
append_scan_tooltip: Append valid channels to existing list without clearing
bookmark_info: Chapters are video built-in. Bookmarks are user-defined. Double-click to seek.
cache_secs_override_desc: Overrides the demuxer cache duration in seconds. Leave 0 to keep the auto value (e.g. 3600s for live, 180s for Blu-ray, dynamically adjusted by resolution).
cannot_seek_live: Cannot seek back: live stream buffer insufficient (try again later)
catchup_not_supported: This channel does not support catchup
clip_export_ffmpeg_not_found_clip: ffmpeg not found. Place ffmpeg in ffmpeg/ directory or install to system PATH
clip_export_ffmpeg_not_found_gif: ffmpeg not found, cannot generate GIF
clip_export_pillow_not_found: Pillow not installed, cannot generate GIF (pip install Pillow)
close_confirm_text: Closing will stop program reminders. Minimize to system tray to keep reminders running?
config_usage: All settings are automatically saved, no manual operation required
confirm_delete_message: Are you sure you want to delete the selected channel?
deinterlace_desc: Deinterlacing for interlaced video (channels with horizontal lines/comb artifacts). 'Auto' uses Yadif Bob mode (mode=1), 50i→50p, maintains original framerate for smooth motion. Requires copy-back hwdec or software decoding.
demuxer_max_bytes_override_desc: Overrides the demuxer forward cache size in MiB. Leave 0 to keep the auto value (scales with cache-secs, capped at 4096MiB).
demuxer_readahead_secs_override_desc: Overrides the demuxer readahead in seconds. Leave 0 to keep the auto value (120s for HLS/HTTP, 300s for TS, 30s for network drives, etc.).
description: IPTV channel scanning and editing tool
epg_subscription: EPG Subscription (all sources will be merged automatically)
file_assoc_hint: After registration, right-click files to open with this program
file_format_error: File format is incorrect or empty
file_not_found: File not found, removed from recent list
framedrop_desc: Frame dropping strategy when video output falls behind. "vo" drops only at output stage (keeps decode quality). "decoder" drops earlier (saves CPU on weak machines).
framedrop_vo: vo (Default, drop when VO is slow)
generate_list_tooltip: Generate URL list only, no validation
gpu_api_hint: Vulkan may improve performance on some GPUs, requires restart
invalid_url_prompt:
The URL format is invalid. Please make sure it contains a complete URL
(e.g. http://example.com/playlist.m3u)
management_usage: Right-click channel list or drag to adjust order
manual_mapping_hint: Only needed when remote mapping cannot correctly identify a channel.
mapping_status_no_cache: No cached data yet ({} mappings loaded)
mapping_status_ok: Up to date | Loaded: {} mappings | Last: {}
mapping_tip_desc:
Remote mapping automatically standardizes channel names.
If the mapping file is updated, click the button below to refresh.
mapping_tooltip: When enabled, scanned channels will auto-match name, logo, group from mapping file
mc_hint: Requires copy-back hwdec or software decoding. Medium+ may significantly increase CPU load.
network_enhance_headers_hint: One header per line, format: Key: Value
network_enhance_proxy_hint:
Supported formats:
  http://host:port
  https://host:port
  socks5://host:port
  socks5h://host:port (DNS via proxy)
Leave empty to disable proxy.
network_enhance_referer_hint: Used to bypass hotlink protection. Leave empty to disable.
no_video_in_folder: No supported video files found in the selected folder
not_bluray_msg: Selected directory is not a valid Blu-ray disc structure (BDMV/STREAM not found)
open_list_tooltip: Import M3U file to channel list for validation
open_playlist_or_import: Open a playlist file or import channels to start watching
open_playlist_success: Playlist opened, click a channel to play
osd_ab_loop_inactive: A-B Loop inactive (set both A and B first)
playback_queue_empty: Queue is empty (open local video files to populate)
playback_usage: Double-click any channel in the channel list
probesize_override_desc: Overrides the demuxer probe size in bytes. Leave 0 for auto (5MB for live streams, 2MB for FCC). Increase if streams fail to load with unspecified pixel format warnings.
reminder_count_info: {count} reminders | Based on channel+program+start time, triggered 60s before start
reminder_info: Reminders are based on specific channel+program+start time, triggered 60s before program starts
resume_list_info: Saved playback positions. Double-click to resume, or use the buttons below.
retry_scan_tooltip: After the first scan completes, retry scanning failed channels
save_m3u_tooltip: Save channel list as M3U format
save_txt_tooltip: Save channel list as TXT format
scan_engine_tooltip: Select the core engine for scanning and validation. mpv: lightweight and efficient, low resource usage; ffprobe: more detailed analysis, broader compatibility
scan_usage: Enter address format in scan settings, click "Full Scan" to start
scene_detect_hint:
Auto-detect content type (anime/sports/movie) based on
resolution, fps, bitrate and dynamically adjust parameters
screenshot_no_video: No video frame for current channel, cannot take screenshot
search_no_scope: Please select at least one search scope
select_mapping_to_delete: Please select a mapping to delete
select_mapping_to_edit: Please select a mapping to edit
shader_hint: GLSL shaders run on GPU, no CPU impact. Place .glsl/.hook files in shaders/ directory
shader_not_found: File not found, place in shaders/ dir
smart_retry_tooltip: Smart retry based on failure reasons: only retry timeout and connection failures, not TCP failures or 404 errors. Automatically loops until no new valid channels found
sr_hint: Scale algorithm applies globally; detail enhance requires copy-back hwdec or software decoding.
sub_open_browser_hint: Opened detail page in browser, please download subtitle manually
sub_search_placeholder: Movie name / file name (empty for hash search)
timeshift_beyond_cache: Beyond buffer range, cannot seek to earlier time
timeshift_beyond_cache_no_epg: Beyond buffer range, no EPG info, cannot auto-timeshift
tools_usage: Access professional tools through the toolbar

usage_content:
## Basic Operations

### 1. Open Playlist
- File menu → Open Playlist (Ctrl+O)
- Supports M3U, M3U8, TXT formats
- Or drag and drop files onto the main window

### 2. Play Channel
- **Double-click** a channel in the list to start playing
- Bottom control panel: ▶ Play / ▮▮ Pause / ■ Stop
- Volume slider to adjust, click icon to mute/unmute
- Speed button to change playback speed, aspect button for ratio
- Fullscreen button or F11
- **↑ ↓** keys to switch channels, **← →** keys to adjust volume

### 3. EPG Program Guide
- Left panel shows current channel program schedule
- Click ◀ / ▶ to navigate dates
- Progress bar shows current program playback position
- Supports EPG data source auto-subscription updates
- EPG URLs in M3U file headers are loaded automatically

### 4. Scan & Organize
- Tools menu → Scan & Organize
- Enter IP range or stream URL (e.g. `239.3.1.[1-100]:8000`)
- Set timeout and thread count, supports append scan and retry
- After scanning, use **Batch Operations**:
  - **Auto Classify**: Automatically group channels by name rules
  - **Clean Names**: Remove brackets, HD suffixes, etc.
  - **Match Logo**: Batch match channel logo images
  - **Assign Fields**: Batch set group, logo and other attributes
  - **Sort by Group**: Auto-sort channels by group

### 5. Verify Channels
- Batch check channel validity, show latency, resolution, etc.
- Smart retry for failed items

### 6. Channel Management
- **Drag & Drop Sort**: Drag to reorder channels
- **Group Filter**: Dropdown to filter by group
- **Right-click Menu**: Delete, copy, clean names, match logos, etc.
- **Channel Classification**: Auto-classify by regex rules
- **Name Cleaning**: Smart removal of redundant info
- **Export**: Save as M3U / TXT / Excel format

## Advanced Features

### Subscription Settings
- Tools menu → Subscription Settings
- Configure multiple playlist and EPG sources, managed independently
- Auto-refresh on expiry and incremental updates
- RTSP transport: TCP/UDP/LAVF selectable

### Channel Mapping
- Tools menu → Channel Mapping Manager
- Visual editing of name, LOGO, group mapping rules

### File Association
- Tools menu → File Association
- Check formats to associate (M3U/M3U8/TXT/Video formats)
- Right-click files in Explorer to open with this program

### Interface Customization
- **Theme Switching**: 5 themes available
- **Language Switching**: Chinese / English
- **Panel Control**: View menu or shortcuts
  - **E** — EPG panel
  - **L** — Channel list panel
  - **M** — Control panel
  - **Y** — Hide/restore all floating panels
  - **Tab** — Toggle OSD info overlay
- **F5** Refresh, **F11** Fullscreen, **Ctrl+Q** Exit

### Timeshift / Catchup
- Multiple catchup types: default / append / shift / flussonic / xc
- Time variable replacement with custom format and timezone offset
- M3U file headers can define global catchup parameters
validation_usage: Open playlist and click "Validate Effectiveness" button
video_3d_360_hint: 360° view control requires the lavfi panorama filter, which may be unavailable on some builds
video_3d_stereo_hint: Select the 3D format matching the source; choose "Normal 2D" for 2D videos
video_sync_desc: A/V sync timing reference. "audio" is the safest default. "display-resample"/"display-tempo" sync to display refresh rate (smoother but may pitch-shift audio).
vo_desc: Selects the video output. "Auto" derives vo from HDR mode (gpu/gpu-next). On macOS, vo is always forced to libmpv (mpv v0.41+ no longer supports wid embedding). gpu-next is required for HDR passthrough/scRGB on Windows.
